campaign.title: Apply the host-authorized numeric edits for dependent_predicate.

initial.code:
FUNCTION CASE004_CLAMP_RENAMED(X)
  CASE004_CLAMP_RENAMED = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    CASE004_CLAMP_RENAMED = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 33) THEN
    CASE004_CLAMP_RENAMED = 33
  END IF
  CASE004_CLAMP_RENAMED = CASE004_CLAMP_RENAMED
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE004_ACCEPTED(X)
  CASE004_ACCEPTED = 0
  IF (CASE004_CLAMP_RENAMED(X) >= 15) THEN
    CASE004_ACCEPTED = 1
  END IF
  CASE004_ACCEPTED = CASE004_ACCEPTED
END FUNCTION
